title: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
titleEnglish: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
synopsis: At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
titleRomaji: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
titleNative: ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
synopsis: Sora Akizuki, a second-year high school boy, confesses his feelings for the kouhai girl Miya Fuwa, but she rejects him because she "likes someone else." The person she likes is... Asahi Suzukaze, the head of the mysterious "Clinical Trial Club." Sora joins the club, only to find out that Asahi also has someone she already likes. He is a boy who once saved Asahi, who was seriously ill, by helping her get through a "clinical trial," so she calls him "the prince of clinical trials." But it turns out that boy is Sora, who was a mischievous elementary school kid at the time.........? This is a high-tension "clinical trial" romantic comedy with a complex intersection of love interests! (Source: Young Animal, translated)

title: Yeti, Toaru Hibi
synopsis: Ordinary days are precious. A relaxed country life with Yeti! Hana Tanaka is a first-year high school student. She lives in the small mountain village of Uzuka, where she runs a public bathhouse with her grandmother and Enta. One day, feeling a bit bored with her unchanging daily routine, a mysterious creature called the “Yeti” arrived from the distant Himalayas! Though there aren't any major changes, she embarks with the Yeti to explore the small “sparks of joy” in her daily life!

title: Roka suru Watashi
synopsis: Yukie is a year older than the rest of her high school class. Because of her flamboyant appearance, she is rumored to be a delinquent and shunned by the other girls. But Sachko's first impression of her was that “she's so cool...” After graduation, Yukie and Sachiko started living together in Tokyo. However, Yukie, an office lady, and Sachiko, the manager of a lesbian bar, have opposite life schedules, so they even though they live in the same house, it's like they live apart from each other. The only time they have together is on Sundays! They were enjoying their day off going out shopping, when they meet a woman who seems familiar...? Note: Published at COMITIA149.

Game Addict Plays "Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons" from a "New Game"
synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items. One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)
